104-2034-3490-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-3490-8333.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

424-868-8218.description:
Cast Sink into Takenuma by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Sink into Takenuma.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Sink into Takenuma, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting a player
Resolve Sink into Takenuma, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

529-3197-7060-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1479-3861-7889.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Dancing from Dark to Dawn, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

121-553-4586.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Hypersonic Dragon.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

4968-6593-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
4968-6593-7803.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Brad Boimler.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4968-6593-7803.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-3455.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-3455.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-3455.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

475-549-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-5641-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-4146-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-4146-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Murmuring Mystic triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3417-3614-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3417-3614-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger indestructible using Heroic Intervention.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3417-3614-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

2060-4331-7455.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4} in four different colors of mana.
Wildgrowth Archaic triggers, causing Crystalline Crawler to enter with four +1/+1 counters on it. It'll enter with a total of eight counters due to its converge ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{W}{U}{U}{B}{R}.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Crystalline Crawler from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

206-1069-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
206-1069-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1169-2457-4094-4289.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

1284-1636-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
When the Faerie enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Pestered Wellguard ability from step 1.
Repeat

57-1753-2341-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
57-1753-2341-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

413-539-7032.description:
Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Dai Li Agents trigger, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

640-5010-5147-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2173-5073-5220-5332.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

104-4186-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-5789.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2499-3389-5954-6763.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4681-5256-6132.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

880-1659-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-1659-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2035-2523-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gollum.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Repeat.

2429-3193-5184.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2429-3193-5184.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

659-1849-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
659-1849-5231.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

1349-4050-5239.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
1349-4050-5239.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden, adding one mana of any color.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden .
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

174-339-1636-2034.notablePrerequisites: Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
174-339-1636-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Worldheart Phoenix enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

953-1295.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}, drawing your library and then putting any card besides Thassa's Oracle from your hand on top of your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

1819-3244-4475.notablePrerequisites: You have twenty or more creature cards in library and/or graveyard.
1819-3244-4475.description:
Cast Morality Shift.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card leaving and entering your graveyard, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.

1385-2178-2393-4283.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Whisper.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other nontoken creatures.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1385-2178-2393-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing two other nontoken creatures.
Sifter of Skulls, Zulaport Cutthroat and Whisper each trigger twice.
Resolve both Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve both Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve both Whisper triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Whisper ability from step 1, returning target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing an Eldrazi Scion token and any other nontoken creature.
Sifter of Skulls triggers once, while Zulaport Cutthroat and Whisper each trigger twice.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

1992-2438-4381.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2438-4381.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter, Carrion Feeder gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Grumgully triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability by dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
